h1: Catalog data setup for better suggestions
overview: Recommendations are only as good as the product data behind them. We audit your catalog for missing tags, mixed collections, odd titles and unclear variants, then fix them in a consistent system. You get clear tag rules, cleaned products and a short guide for adding new ones the same way. We work in your store admin with a backup first, so every change can be undone if needed.

pkgs.blurb: A catalog audit and cleanup of up to 50 products.
Up to 200 products cleaned with a tag and collection system.
Up to 500 products with attributes, variants and a data guide.

faq: Will you change my product pages?
We change tags, collections, attributes and variant names, not your photos or main descriptions unless you ask. You approve the tag system first, and we keep a backup file of the original data.
Why does catalog data affect suggestions?
Recommendation tools match products by tags, collections and attributes. If a bag is tagged as shoes, it will be suggested with shoes. Clean data means matches that make sense to shoppers.
Can you do this with a spreadsheet?
Yes. For larger catalogs we often export products, edit them in a sheet and import them back after a test batch. We show you a sample before the full import.
